title: Discovery Call Checklist
summary: Operator-curated discovery checklist for first serious conversations. Reference guidance only — not observed evidence.
content_text: Confirm decision-maker presence, current process, pain cost, timing, budget authority, and next-step agreement. Capture objections verbatim. Do not invent facts about the prospect.

provenance.notes: Internal operator summary for Max bootstrap; not a copyrighted methodology reprint.
